title: The filter named the empty corner 🎭
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark moody blue-teal grade, one bright light source, well exposed, 35mm film grain, realistic, no text, no watermark, no faces
hook_text: At 1:26 a.m. a filter gave the empty corner of my room a name.

scenes.narration: At 1:26 a.m. a filter gave the empty corner of my room a name.
It was one of those filters that tells you which character you are. I pointed the camera at my face. Then I swung it round, just for a joke.

shots.prompt: hand holding a phone in a dark bedroom, bright screen glow, no face

scenes.narration: The corner of the room was empty. The filter scanned it anyway. A little spinning circle. A soft chime.

shots.prompt: phone screen glowing pointed at an empty dark corner, no text, no person

scenes.narration: A label popped up over nothing. Character match. Ninety-eight percent. It named a villain from a horror film.

shots.prompt: phone screen with a bright glowing circle over an empty dark corner, no text

scenes.narration: I laughed. Then the label moved. One step to the left. Toward the bed.

shots.prompt: dark bedroom seen through a phone camera, one blurry bright shape near the bed, no face

scenes.narration: I tried another corner. Match again. Same name. Same percentage. It was in every corner I pointed at.

shots.prompt: phone camera sweeping a dark room, bright glowing circles on the walls, no text

scenes.narration: I turned the filter back on myself. The circle spun for a long time. The chime sounded twice.

shots.prompt: phone glowing in a dark room, bright circular loading ring on screen, no text, no face

scenes.narration: The label said, Match found. Ninety-nine percent. And the name it gave me was the same one.

shots.prompt: bright phone screen reflecting on a dark wall, blurry glowing label, no text

scenes.narration: I put the phone down. Behind me, something chimed.

shots.prompt: dark bedroom corner with a faint pale glow and a silhouette shape, no face

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do you delete the filter, or point it at the corner again?
